This is likely because the PATH resolution is picking up the old npm-installed version instead of the new native installer version at `~/.local/bin/claude`.

2. The old npm version was at `/home/lijian/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin/claude` (or similar nvm path)
3. If the nvm path comes before `~/.local/bin` in PATH, the old version would be picked up

text:
说明 PATH 里旧的 npm 版本路径优先级更高，先被找到了。查一下：

```bash
which claude
```

大概率显示的是 nvm 路径（如 `~/.nvm/versions/node/v20.20.2/bin/claude`），而不是 `~/.local/bin/claude`。

修复方法——把 `~/.local/bin` 提到 PATH 前面。在 `~/.bashrc` 里加一行：

```bash
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"
```

然后 `source ~/.bashrc`，再运行 `claude` 就是 2.1.204 了。
